title: Exodus Bible Quiz - Chapter 17
description: Ten questions on Exodus 17: water from the rock at Horeb and the battle with Amalek at Rephidim.

questions.text: Where did the congregation encamp when there was no water to drink?
questions.explanation: They traveled from the wilderness of Sin and encamped in Rephidim, but there was no water for the people to drink.

questions.text: What did Moses tell Yahweh the people were almost ready to do?
questions.explanation: Moses cried to Yahweh: 'What shall I do with these people? They are almost ready to stone me.'

answers.text: To build an altar to other gods

questions.text: Where did Yahweh say he would stand before Moses on the rock?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said: 'I will stand before you there on the rock in Horeb. You shall strike the rock, and water will come out of it.'

questions.text: What names did Moses give the place where water came from the rock?
questions.explanation: He called the place Massah and Meribah, because the people quarreled and tested Yahweh.

questions.text: Who came and fought with Israel in Rephidim?
questions.explanation: Amalek came and fought with Israel in Rephidim.

questions.text: Whom did Moses tell to choose men and go out to fight?
questions.explanation: Moses said to Joshua: 'Choose men for us, and go out, fight with Amalek.'

questions.text: What happened when Moses held up his hand?
questions.explanation: When Moses held up his hand, Israel prevailed; when he let it down, Amalek prevailed.

questions.text: Who held up Moses' hands when they grew heavy?
questions.explanation: Aaron and Hur held up his hands, one on each side, and his hands were steady until sunset.

questions.text: What did Yahweh tell Moses to write in a book as a memorial?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told Moses to write that he would utterly blot out the memory of Amalek from under the sky.

answers.text: The names of all who fought
That he would blot out the memory of Amalek
The way from Egypt to Rephidim
The words spoken at the rock

questions.text: What name did Moses give the altar he built?
questions.explanation: Moses built an altar and called its name 'Yahweh our Banner'.
